headline: Deputy Minister of National Economy and Finance on Tsipras' proposals on fuel: "The key element is missing: the arithmetic"
summary: The Ministry of National Economy and Finance said some proposals on fuel clash with European rules and others cost billions. It said the numbers do not add up.
why: Fuel price and tax measures affect household inflation, public finances and the fiscal path that Greece must keep within EU rules.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude
